de.name: Villa Monastero

de.name: Castello di Vezio

de.name: Chiesa di San Giorgio

de.name: Villa Cipressi
de.text: Ein Gebäudekomplex mit terrassierten Gärten aus verschiedenen Epochen, heute ein Hotel und Park.

de.name: Passeggiata degli Innamorati

de.name: Sorgente del Fiumelatte
de.text: Einer der kürzesten Flüsse Italiens, der nur zeitweise fließt und milchig-weiß aus dem Felsen bricht.

de.name: Chiesa di San Giovanni Battista

de.name: Imbarcadero di Varenna

de.name: Riva Grande

de.name: Museo Ornitologico

hu.name: Museo Ornitologico

ro.name: Sorgente del Fiumelatte

ro.name: Riva Grande

ro.name: Museo Ornitologico
ro.text: Muzeul ornitologic găzduit în interiorul primăriei, prezentând o colecție bogată de păsări din regiune.

en.name: Villa Monastero
en.text: A former monastery turned into a villa, famous for its 2km-long botanical garden along Lake Como.

en.name: Castello di Vezio
en.text: A medieval fortress ruin overlooking Varenna, known for its falconry displays and panoramic lake views.

en.name: Chiesa di San Giorgio
en.text: The main church on the central square, built in the 14th century with impressive medieval frescoes.

en.name: Villa Cipressi
en.text: A complex of historical buildings surrounded by stunning terraced gardens descending to the waterfront.

en.name: Passeggiata degli Innamorati
en.text: The Lovers' Walk is a scenic red pedestrian path suspended over the water, leading to the village center.

en.name: Sorgente del Fiumelatte
en.text: One of Italy's shortest rivers, emerging milky-white from the rock and flowing only seasonally.

en.name: Chiesa di San Giovanni Battista
en.text: One of the lake's oldest churches, featuring simple Romanesque architecture and ancient wall paintings.

en.name: Imbarcadero di Varenna
en.text: The bustling ferry terminal, the primary access point for boats connecting Varenna to Bellagio and Menaggio.

en.name: Riva Grande
en.text: Varenna's charming waterfront promenade lined with colorful houses, cafes, and small pebble beaches.

en.name: Museo Ornitologico
en.text: Located in the Town Hall, this museum displays a collection of local bird species and natural history exhibits.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Varenna ist das Juwel am Ostufer des Comer Sees und hat sich im Gegensatz zum mondänen Bellagio seinen rustikalen Charme bewahrt. Die Häuser schmiegen sich eng an den steilen Hang und sind durch steile Treppengassen miteinander verbunden. Ein Highlight ist der 'Passerella degli Innamorati', ein roter Steg, der am Felsen entlang über das Wasser führt. Über dem Ort thront das Castello di Vezio, wo heute Greifvogelvorführungen stattfinden und man einen der besten Panoramablicke über den See hat. Die Villa Monastero, ein ehemaliges Kloster, beeindruckt mit einem fast zwei Kilometer langen botanischen Garten direkt am Seeufer. Varenna ist durch seine direkte Bahnanbindung an Mailand ein beliebtes Ziel für Tagesausflügler.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Varenna a Comói-tó keleti partjának egyik legvonzóbb települése, amely meredek domboldalra épült, és megőrizte középkori halászfalu jellegét. A városka központját szűk, kővel burkolt sikátorok hálózzák be, amelyek a part menti sétányhoz, a híres „Szerelmesek útjához” (Passerella degli Innamorati) vezetnek. A település egyik legfőbb nevezetessége a Villa Monastero, amely egykori kolostorból alakult át nemesi rezidenciává; hatalmas botanikus kertje több kilométer hosszan nyúlik el a tóparton. A falu felett magasodik a Castello di Vezio romja, ahonnan páratlan kilátás nyílik a tó három ágára és Bellagio szemközti partjaira. Varenna csendesebb és autentikusabb alternatívát kínál a felkapottabb üdülőhelyekkel szemben, miközben kiváló kompösszeköttetései révén ideális kiindulópont a tó felfedezéséhez.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Varenna este o bijuterie a lacului Como, situată pe malul estic, fiind renumită pentru arhitectura sa medievală și atmosfera liniștită. Satul este structurat pe o pantă abruptă, cu străduțe înguste și trepte de piatră care coboară spre portul pitoresc. Unul dintre punctele de atracție principale este „Calea Îndrăgostiților”, o pasarelă suspendată deasupra apei care oferă vederi spectaculoase spre munții din jur. Villa Monastero, cu grădinile sale botanice luxuriante ce adăpostesc specii rare de plante, reprezintă un punct de referință cultural și istoric major. Deasupra satului se află Castelul Vezio, o fortăreață medievală unde vizitatorii pot asista la demonstrații de șoimărit și pot admira o panoramă vastă asupra lacului. Cu doar 700 de locuitori, Varenna oferă o experiență mult mai autentică decât localitățile vecine mai aglomerate.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Varenna stands as one of the most enchanting destinations on the eastern shore of Lake Como, defined by its steep layout and preserved medieval charm. Unlike its busier neighbors, this village of 700 residents retains an intimate atmosphere, with narrow stone alleys leading down to the waterfront. The scenic "Walk of Lovers" provides a romantic path along the shoreline, connecting the ferry terminal to the historic center. Architecture enthusiasts are drawn to the Villa Monastero, a former convent transformed into a grand villa, featuring a linear botanical garden that stretches for nearly two kilometers along the lake. High above the town, the ruins of Castello di Vezio offer a strategic vantage point overlooking the central part of the lake. Varenna serves as a vital transport hub with its train station and frequent ferry links to Bellagio and Menaggi.
